description:
I teach live, clean (without accent) Russian, not just bookish.

Accessible and not boring and with a guarantee of results from a native speaker

Free testing of the level of Russian and accelerated learning of the language, thanks to lyfhakami from polyglots!
I also conduct group classes in companies or if you bring a friend/relative and are engaged either separately or at the same time, depending on the size of the group the price per hour is less, I make discounts.



There is experience of teaching both on courses, and in school and as a private tutor (total 10 years) and education of the teacher of Russian and additional psychological, experience of dialogue and stay in a pure Russian-speaking environment.

I can prepare for any exams, master the school programme, study it for work or business, overcome the language barrier and immerse in a pure Russian-speaking environment or raise the level to conversational for moving.

My clients are top entrepreneurs and successful professionals and large companies with whom we have a long and fruitful co-operation.
